rationale: The candidate reads as one dominant compact mass with a carved interior void, and the four views are broadly coherent rather than contradictory. It responds to the parcel without simply filling the box: the mass is rotated/angled within the boundary and the void creates some public figure. The street edge response is present but only moderately legible; the access-side condition does not yet feel strongly opened or inhabited at ground level. The silhouette is coherent as a single object, but some views suggest faceting and a somewhat arbitrary stepped/waisted top rather than a clearly sectioned program mass. For neighborhood living, this is plausible as a compact mixed-use or community building, but the section still needs a clearer active ground threshold and a more program-relevant upper/roof logic to better support the brief.
